collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — LUCK, OMENS AND LAVASTONES (LO-01 to LO-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)
the owner's naming rule (2026-11-15): a person the draft names by role is a cast villager, named at the first mention

collection.description: A villager's palm has been itching all morning, which means a gift is coming: wait for it, or forget it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject)'s right palm has been itching all morning. Everyone knows what that means: a gift is coming. (subject) has been walking around with (subject.his/her) hand slightly open, just in case, and has told several people about it. (friend) thinks this is ridiculous.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) waits all day. Nothing. At dinner, (friend), with a perfectly straight face, puts a small shell into (subject)'s itchy palm. "There," (friend.he/she) says. "Your gift." (subject) looks at it. "That doesn't count." "It's a gift. In your palm." (subject) keeps the shell. The itching, (subject.he/she) notes later, has stopped.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) scratches it and gets on with things. That afternoon, (neighbor), a neighbor, brings over a basket of fruit for no reason at all, just because there was too much. (subject) looks at the basket, then at (subject.his/her) palm, then at (friend). (friend) refuses to say anything. (subject) says a great deal.
